description: HTML source code for a web-based database visualizer interface, including styles and client-side JavaScript to load and display database and table data dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by reloading the data from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the display of tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders a data table in the HTML with fetched database data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cell content based on value type.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles expanding and collapsing of cell content for long or object data.
